property_summary: Any successful fallback call (msg.value == 10 ether, timestamp strictly greater than pastBlockTime) must record that timestamp in pastBlockTime regardless of block number, so a second call at the same timestamp always reverts; the mutant fails to record it when block.number % 15 != 0, letting the second call succeed.
change_summary: Move 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;' inside the if-branch so pastBlockTime is only updated when the payout branch executes.
